title: WONDERFUL PROMISES AND WISDOM

blocks.text: “Here are some dynamic and wonderful promises and wisdom concerning the mind of God, our Saviour the Lord Jesus!” – Isa. 26:3-4, “teaches as our mind thinks daily of the Lord He will keep us in perfect peace! No matter how confused the world is or how perplexed in crisis, He has promised us peace and rest!” – “We are not to just trust the Lord when we need Him, but always!” “Trust ye in the Lord for ever: for the Lord JE-HO-VAH is everlasting strength!” – Isa. 28:29, “This also cometh forth from the Lord of Hosts which is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in working!” – Isa. 40:8, “The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand forever! – See saith Jesus, I shall not fail thee, but shall lead thee in greater knowledge and wonderful wisdom concerning things not yet done, and things soon to be!” “Listen! – Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them!” (Isa. 42:9)

“Herein is another beautiful Scripture revealing that His ears are always listening to help us!” – Isa. 40:28, “Hast thou not known? Hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the Lord, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? There is no searching of his understanding.” – Isa. 41:13, “For I the Lord thy God will hold thy right hand saying unto thee, Fear not: I will help thee!” – “Take courage He will send to you a wonderful reviving spirit of restoration!” Verse 18, “I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, the dry land springs of water!”– Isa. 43:7, “reveals that we are created for His glory and He is definitely ever ready to bless, save and heal!” – Rev. 4:11 – “reveals what we mean to Jesus!”

“Herein is some more real valuable knowledge!” - Isa. 43:10-11, “The Lord says we are His witnesses, and that ye may know this revelation.” – Quote, “And understand that I am he; before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me! I, even I, am the Lord; and beside me there is no Saviour!” – “He is simply saying that He is Jesus which is, which was, and which is to come, the Almighty!” (Rev. 1:8) – “When your heart and mind believe this there is a tremendous peace and satisfaction and answers to prayers come ever so more quickly!” – Read ye this, Isa. 44:6, “Thus saith the Lord the King of Israel, and his redeemer the Lord of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God!” – “Knowing who Jesus is, will encourage you to believe for even greater things!”

Here are some reprints and important promises: I’m grateful that the Lord has chosen you to be one of my helpers in this ministry and to be involved in the usual wonders, miracles and the saving of souls! – “He will not overlook you at any time; but trust ye in the Lord forever and He will give you rest, peace, prosperity and quietness of soul!” – “And will make a way of escape out of any anxiety, problem and trouble that confronts you! During these perilous times He will never leave nor forsake you whether a person be young or old! The Bible is definite concerning these promises!”

Isa. 30:15 reveals, “In quietness and in confidence shall be your strength!” – “And blessed are they that wait for Him!” – “Thus saith the Lord concerning the work of my hands, Command ye me!” Isa. 45:11 – “See He is ever ready to help you as we pray together!” – Verse 19, “says, He has not spoken in secret or in a dark place concerning His promises, and we do not seek Him in vain, He hears us always!” “No matter how discouraged or heartbroken, He is very near!” (St. John 14:27) – “He will give you rest and He will strengthen you! (Matt. 11:28) He will always help and uphold you as you trust!” – “The days of harvest are here. Continue to work in this wonderful calling and gathering of the elect sheaves, the true vine!”

“The Scriptures are full of promises of prosperity for those who support His work!” Ps. 105:37, “He brought them forth also with silver and gold, and there was not one feeble person among their tribes!” Verse 41, “mentions he opened the rock and the blessing came forth!” “Behold saith the Lord read Prov. 11:25, The liberal soul shall be made fat and he that watereth shall be watered also himself!” “To help send forth the good news of the message is the life of fulfillment and joy! Jesus will make a way for you to do it!” St. John 16:23, “In that day whatsoever you ask, He will give it to you!” Read Josh. 1:7, “That thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest!” – Ps. 1:3, “And whatsoever you doeth shall prosper!” Deut. 28:12, “And the Lord shall open up His good treasure to thee!” – “As you open up yours to Him, He will open up His to you!” St. Matt. 7:7, “Ask and it shall be given you, seek and you shall find!” – “Believe His prophets so shall you prosper!” (II Chr. 20:20) “The Lord will not alter what He has spoken” (Ps. 89:34) – “This is the hour for Jesus to bless those who are helping in the harvest! He has promised a rich harvest!” (James 5:7 – Mark 4:20) – “Some thirty fold, some sixty and some a hundred,” (in verse 29). There are ever so many Scriptures to bear out God’s promises, and now here are some Scriptures of healing faith:

Acts 4:30, “God is stretching forth His hand to heal!” Acts 10:38, “Jesus healed ALL who were sick and oppressed of the devil!” Matt 9:35, “Jesus healed every sickness and disease among the people! And this promise is for YOU too!” Matt. 4:23, “Jesus preached and healed ALL manner of sickness among the people! He wants to touch you now, claim it!” Ps. 103:3, “Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases!” – Ps.107:20, “He sent His Word and healed them! And the power of the Lord is now present upon you to heal and prosper you as you believe from this day forward!” Luke 5:17-20 – “We are joint heirs of what the Lord has by faith!” Hag. 2:8, “The Lord owns it all, including the silver and gold!” “The healing and prosperity blessings belong to you!” Act! “Behold saith the Lord Jesus, let us conclude with this Scripture, III John 1:2, “Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth!” – “So let’s agree together for His blessing!”
